 Predators at Ducks projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 11, 2026 
 Link copied 
 PREDATORS (9-4-5) at DUCKS (10-7-1) 
 10 p.m. ET; FOXLA+, Prime Video, SCRIPPS 
 Predators projected lineup 
 Steven Stamkos -- Ryan O'Reilly -- Mavrik Bourque
 Filip Forsberg -- Shane Wright -- Nils Hoglander
 Reid Schaefer -- Alexander Kerfoot -- Vitali Pinchuk
 Ross Colton -- Jack Drury -- Adam Edstrom
 Roman Josi -- Adam Wilsby
 Brady Skjei -- Nick Perbix
 Daemon Hunt -- Jayden Struble
 Justus Annunen
 Juuse Saros
 Scratched: Nicolas Hague, Ilya Lyubushkin 
 Injured: Jonathan Marchessault (lower body), William Trudeau (upper body) 
 Ducks projected lineup 
 Alex Killorn -- Leo Carlsson -- Judd Caulfield
 Cutter Gauthier -- Mikael Granlund -- Beckett Sennecke
 Nikita Nesterenko -- Tim Washe -- Troy Terry
 Jeff Malott -- Roger McQueen -- Sam Colangelo
 Jackson LaCombe -- Drew Helleson
 Pavel Mintyukov -- Noah Warren
 Travis Mitchell -- Tristan Luneau
 Laurent Brossoit
 Ville Husso
 Scratched: Tyson Hinds, Frank Vatrano, Lukas Dostal 
 Injured: A.J. Greer (upper body), Ian Moore (lower body), Ryan Poehling (MCL) 
 Status report  
 The Predators did not hold a morning skate following their 3-0 win at the Los Angeles Kings on Tuesday. ... Annunen will likely start after Saros made 30 saves. ... Terry will make his season debut after recovering from surgery June 9 to address hip impingement and a labral tear. ... The Ducks returned forward Nico Myatovic to San Diego of the American Hockey League on Wednesday.
